Alex: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Alex: Did: merged Node quickstart PR (minor README tweaks), added DKIM note to onboarding doc, and wired the sampleapp CI job to the new matrix.
Alex: Blocker: macOS CI is flaking on wheel build (openssl linkage). Need someone with mac runner access to try a rebuild.
Alex: Today: finish the sampleapp README, open a follow-up PR to normalize env var names.
Sam: Re: macCI, can you paste the failing log? I can try a manual rerun after that. :coffee: 
Alex: Error snippet:
```
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
/usr/local/opt/openssl@1.1/lib/libcrypto.dylib: used dynamic __LINKEDIT
```
Sam: Hmm, looks like the openssl@1.1 path. I'll try `brew reinstall openssl@1.1` on the mac builder and re-run.
Priya: FYI I updated Python SDK quickstart to streaming examples and clarified auth steps. PR #432 ready for review.
Priya: Blocker: wording around "Dedicated" vs "Reserved capacity" in the quickstart — which term should we standardize on?
Jules: DocsBot: consensus in style guide is to use "Dedicated (reserved capacity)" on first mention, then "Dedicated" afterwards. I'll leave a comment on PR to that effect.
DocsBot: Deployed docs preview: https://docs.redwood.inference/preview/432 — build passed.
Priya: Thanks — I'll update phrasing. Also added a tiny sample demonstrating prefix caching; need someone to sanity-check perf numbers (latency and token savings).
Sam: I'll run the prefix-cache sample locally this afternoon and post results in this thread. Please drop the repro steps.
Alex: Repro: `git checkout sample/prefix-cache && ./run_local.sh --profile=small`; env: REDWOOD_API_KEY set to staging key. Also note the sample writes a small trace to `./out/trace.json`.
Sam: Got it. If I hit the CI failure while testing, I'll capture logs and tag @Alex.
Jules: Quick ops note: I'm consolidating the quickstarts section — moving Node/Python into a single "Getting started" index. Expect a follow-up PR tomorrow.
Alex: OK handoff: if Sam can validate CI and prefix cache perf, I'll cut the docs PR and we can ship the change to main. :thumbsup:
DocsBot: Reminder: docs audit checklist due Friday — add any quickstart changes to the audit doc: /docs-audit.
Priya: One last ask — can someone sanity-check the sampleapp's env var naming? I switched KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY to match SDKs.
Sam: I'll check naming while running the sample.
Jules: Thanks team — if nobody else has blockers, I'll mark this as done for today. :white_check_mark:
